pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Semgrep is a fast, lightweight static analysis tool for finding bugs, enforcing code standards, and detecting security vulnerabilities in many languages using pattern-based rules that look like the source code itself.
This package installs Semgrep from the official prebuilt PyPI wheel, including the Python CLI, native semgrep-core engine, and bundled shared libraries. The ebuild repairs the binary RUNPATH and integrates the wheel into Gentoo's Python installation. It does not build semgrep-core from OCaml source, and it does not depend on a separate semgrep-core package.
Cross-overlay dependency notice: this ebuild's dependency graph relies on several packages that exist only in ::guru, not ::gentoo, namely dev-python/opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http, dev-python/opentelemetry-instrumentation, dev-python/opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading, dev-python/httpx-sse, and dev-python/sse-starlette (the last two via dev-python/mcp). None of these are copied into this package's own RDEPEND; they are pulled in transitively through the packages that actually declare them. A plain local-repository pkgcheck scan (pkgcheck scan --repo <this overlay>) reports several of them as nonexistent/nonsolvable because it does not evaluate the full enabled repository set (::gentoo + ::guru + this overlay); they were independently confirmed resolvable against the live Portage database, repo-qualified per package.
